title: [Runner] Fix false-positive Win+Shift+C shortcut conflict on Windows 11

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: Fixture validation remains unfinished and the product runner has not executed. After the generated sentinel script parsed, its disposal assertion exposed a fixture counter-scope measurement bug; an observable disposal marker was prepared without changing the production runner. The next file-based invocation then stopped while reporting because Windows PowerShell 5.1 lacks the SHA256.HashData API. Sentinel assertions did not complete, and no lock, restore, build, discovery or product test ran. The entire private fixture, runner and guard are being checked for a consistent host-runtime contract before another execution. The original product preflight error remains unrecovered.
